intro.fr: Castle Crashers Remastered a son Enemy Randomizer, publié sur GameBanana.
intro.en: Castle Crashers Remastered has its Enemy Randomizer, released on GameBanana.

text.fr: The Behemoth sort Castle Crashers en 2008 ; la version Remastered sort en 2015.
text.en: The Behemoth releases Castle Crashers in 2008; the Remastered version comes out in 2015.

text.fr: Un mod « Enemy Randomizer » pour Castle Crashers Remastered est disponible sur GameBanana.
text.en: An "Enemy Randomizer" mod for Castle Crashers Remastered is available on GameBanana.
